name: how-to-use
title_zh: 编辑器问你能干嘛时，照这份稿答三句就够
tagline_zh: 面板初次打开、用户愣住的那十秒，最怕你长篇大论背说明书。这份稿子替你压成三句人话，还主动递出第一个活儿。
tagline_en: That first blank stare at the panel is no time for a spec sheet. This file boils you down to three human.
desc_en: Use when the editor asks what you can do or how to use the panel. Answer from this file, short, in plain words. Offer to start on one.
why_zh: 它不存功能清单，只存「怎么开口」。每次回答都从用户手头那一步起跳，不背菜单，只指路。
why_en: No feature list, just an opening move. Every reply starts from what the user is already doing, pointing to a path instead of.
limit_zh: 只覆盖「用户问你会做什么/怎么用面板」这一种开场。若用户直接报需求、或问具体操作步骤，它答不上来。
limit_en: Only covers the 'what can you do / how to use' opener. Direct requests or step-by-step how-tos fall through — another skill must catch those.
title_en: When the editor asks what you do, answer in three plain.
